name: tia_create_device
description: Create a device (station) from a catalog type identifier with Devices.CreateWithItem, e.g. 'OrderNumber:6ES7 214-1AG40-0XB0/V4.6' for a CPU or 'GSD:<gsdml file>/DAP/<id>' for a GSDML IO device such as a drive's fieldbus adapter. Fails if the device name already exists. dry_run=true (default) only validates the name and checks the type in the catalog.

type_identifier.description: Complete type identifier of the head module (from tia_find_module_types or the TIA catalog 'Article number'/version).

device_item_name.description: Name of the created head device item, e.g. 'PLC_1'.

device_name.description: Optional station name; TIA generates one when omitted.
